Signal and execution assumptions

Each complete three-candle pattern falls inside the live recording. Earlier candles supply the lookback history. A sharp body covers at least 68% of its own range and exceeds % of the mean high–low range of the previous bars of either color. Candle 2 alone must be sharp. A doji has no color.

Both sharp colors can generate buys. Entry is low 3, stop is low 1. The target is high 3 for matching colors and low 3 otherwise. An opposite-color or doji third candle therefore has its target at entry and is skipped. Only stop < entry < target qualifies. Orders activate after candle 3 and expire after 10 minutes if unfilled.

Each order uses $1,000 of independent notional and can overlap others. The first recorded trade at or below the limit fills at the limit. From that print onward, the first stop breach exits at the observed price, or a target touch exits at target. Same-millisecond prints use ascending trade ID. Fills assume sufficient liquidity. Recording gaps can affect event order and fills. The model assumes resting maker entries and take-profit orders (0.015% per fill), and taker stop exits (0.045%). Fees use each fill’s notional at Hyperliquid’s base perpetual tier. Net P&L deducts all incurred fees including open entry fees. Funding and extra slippage are excluded. Win rate and profit factor use closed trades after fees. Hyperliquid fee schedule.
